preconditions.description: The number of glades n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of trails m must be between 0 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in trails)
preconditions.description: Each trail must connect glades within the valid range from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if is_eulerian else stdout == str(min_trails_needed)
postconditions.description: If the walk is possible, output 0; otherwise, output the minimum number of trails needed.
